demos.name: Arnold Press
cues: Start seated with dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Rotate your palms outward as you press overhead.
Reverse the motion on the way down.

demos.name: Back Extension
cues: Set the pad just below your hip bones on the extension bench, feet locked in.
Hinge down with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Rise until your body is straight; do not hyperextend past neutral.

demos.name: Band Chest Press
cues: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward to tension the band, then press both hands forward until straight.
Return under control. Step further forward to progress.

demos.name: Band Curl
cues: Stand on the band and hold the handles, palms up.
Curl to your shoulders with elbows still.
Lower slowly against the band.

demos.name: Band Face Pull
cues: Anchor the band at face height and grip with palms in.
Pull toward your face, elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then return under control.

demos.name: Band Chest Fly
cues: Anchor the band behind you at chest height, one handle in each hand.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in an arc.
Return slowly under tension.

demos.name: Band Good Morning
cues: Stand on the band and loop the other end behind your neck across your upper back.
Hinge forward with a flat back, then drive your hips through to stand.
Keep the tension on the band by standing fully tall at the top.

demos.name: Band Lat Pulldown
cues: Anchor the band high and kneel or sit facing it.
Pull the handles down to your shoulders, elbows driving to your sides.
Return slowly overhead.

demos.name: Band Lateral Walk
cues: Loop a band just above your knees and sit into a quarter squat.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band and your knees pushed out.
Take the same number of steps back the other way.

demos.name: Band Pallof Press
cues: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on holding it at your chest.
Press straight out and hold against the rotation.
Return and repeat; switch sides.

demos.name: Band Pull-Apart
cues: Hold the band in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

demos.name: Band Triceps Pushdown
cues: Anchor the band high and hold the ends with elbows at your sides.
Push down to straight arms.
Return slowly, keeping the elbows still.

demos.name: Band Row
cues: Anchor the band in front of you at chest height, or loop it around your feet while seated.
Row the handles to your ribs, elbows close to your sides.
Return slowly, letting your shoulder blades spread.

demos.name: Band Shoulder Press
cues: Stand on the band and bring the handles to your shoulders.
Press straight overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.

demos.name: Resistance Band Squat
cues: Stand on the band with both feet and bring the handles or loop up to your shoulders.
Squat down under control; the band gets lighter at the bottom and heavier at the top.
Stand tall against the band. Shorten the band or double it to progress.

demos.name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Set the bar across your upper back, hands just outside your shoulders, and unrack it with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Brace your trunk, then sit down and back, keeping your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, then drive through the whole foot to stand.
Keep your chest up throughout; the bar should travel in a straight vertical line.

demos.name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar, feet planted, shoulder blades pulled together.
Grip just wider than shoulder-width, unrack, and lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press up and slightly back toward the rack, keeping your wrists straight and elbows tucked at about 45 degrees.

demos.name: Barbell Curl
cues: Stand holding the bar with an underhand grip at shoulder-width.
Curl the bar to your shoulders without swinging; elbows stay at your sides.
Lower under control to straight arms.

demos.name: Barbell Front Squat
cues: Rack the bar on the front of your shoulders with elbows high and fingertips under the bar.
Keep your elbows up and torso vertical as you sit straight down between your feet.
Go as deep as you can hold your torso upright, then stand up driving the elbows up.

demos.name: Barbell Lunge
cues: Bar on your upper back, step forward into a lunge.
Lower until the rear knee is just off the floor.
Push back to the start and alternate legs. Keep the bar steady and your torso upright.

demos.name: Barbell Preacher Curl
cues: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Curl the bar up until your forearms are nearly vertical.
Lower slowly, stopping just short of locking out.

demos.name: Barbell Row
cues: Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back, holding the bar at arm's length.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Lower under control without letting your torso rise.

demos.name: Belt Squat
cues: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platform, feet shoulder-width.
Squat down with your chest up until your thighs are about parallel.
Stand back up by driving through your whole foot.

demos.name: Bench Dip
cues: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands beside your hips, then slide your hips off.
Lower by bending the elbows to about 90 degrees; keep them pointing back.
Press back up. Straighten your legs to progress.

demos.name: Bicycle Crunch
cues: Lie on your back, hands beside your head, legs raised.
Bring one knee in while rotating the opposite elbow toward it.
Alternate sides in a slow, controlled rhythm.

demos.name: Bird Dog
cues: Start on all fours with a flat back.
Extend one arm and the opposite leg until they are level with your torso.
Hold briefly, return, and alternate. Keep your hips level.

demos.name: Bodyweight Lunge
cues: Step forward and lower until both knees are at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee over the foot.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

demos.name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width apart, arms out in front for balance.
Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are parallel or lower.
Stand up fully, squeezing your glutes at the top. Add a pause or tempo to progress.

demos.name: Bodyweight Step-Up
cues: Place one foot fully on a step or bench.
Stand up on it using only the top leg, then lower slowly.
Raise the step height to progress.

demos.name: Box Squat
cues: Set a box or bench at a height that puts your thighs at parallel when seated.
Squat back onto the box, sit fully but stay braced, then stand without rocking.
Useful for learning depth and building starting strength out of the hole.

demos.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Rest the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you, holding dumbbells.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front foot. Complete all reps on one leg before switching.

variants.name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
variants.note: A barbell on your upper back instead of dumbbells.

demos.name: Cable Crunch
cues: Kneel facing a high pulley holding a rope beside your head.
Crunch down, bringing your elbows toward your knees by rounding your spine.
Return slowly, keeping your hips still.

demos.name: Cable Curl
cues: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand close.
Curl the bar to your shoulders, elbows fixed at your sides.
Lower under constant tension.

demos.name: Cable Fly
cues: Set both pulleys at chest height and stand a step forward with a handle in each hand.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in an arc.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

demos.name: Cable Hammer Curl
cues: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold it with your palms facing each other.
Curl the rope up, elbows by your sides.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

demos.name: Cable Hip Abduction
cues: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and stand side-on with the far leg strapped.
Lift the leg out to the side against the cable.
Return slowly. Switch legs after all reps.

demos.name: Cable Glute Kickback
cues: Strap one ankle to a low pulley and face the machine, hands on the frame.
Kick the leg straight back, squeezing the glute, without arching your back.
Return slowly. Switch legs after all reps.

demos.name: Cable Lateral Raise
cues: Stand side-on to a low pulley with the handle in the far hand.
Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower under constant tension. Switch sides after all reps.

demos.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
cues: Face away from a low pulley holding a rope overhead.
Lower the rope behind your head, elbows pointing up.
Extend to straight arms.

demos.name: Cable Pull-Through
cues: Face away from a low pulley with the rope between your legs.
Hinge at the hips, letting the rope travel back, keeping your back flat.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.

demos.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
cues: Stand side-on to a high pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Pull the handle across and out to the side with a straight arm.
Return slowly. Switch sides after all reps.

demos.name: Cable Woodchopper
cues: Set a cable high, stand side-on and hold the handle with both hands.
Rotate your torso to pull the handle down and across your body, arms long.
Return slowly, finish the set, then switch to the other side.

demos.name: Cable Y-Raise
cues: Set two low pulleys and hold the opposite handles with your arms crossed in front.
Raise your arms up and out into a Y shape, thumbs up, to just above shoulder height.
Lower slowly back to the start.

demos.name: Chest Dip
cues: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Lean your chest slightly forward and lower until your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms. Stop higher if your shoulders complain.

demos.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row both dumbbells up, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly. The bench removes any lower-back strain.

demos.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cues: Grip the bar at about shoulder-width, no narrower.
Lower to your lower chest with elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press up, finishing with your arms straight over your shoulders.

demos.name: Concentration Curl
cues: Sit with your elbow braced against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up to your shoulder.
Lower slowly. Do all reps on one arm before switching.

demos.name: Conventional Deadlift
cues: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, feet hip-width. Hinge down and grip just outside your legs.
Flatten your back, pull the slack out of the bar, and push the floor away.
Keep the bar against your legs the whole way; stand tall without leaning back.
Lower by pushing your hips back first, then bending the knees once the bar passes them.

demos.name: Crunch
cues: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands beside your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, keeping your lower back down.
Lower slowly. Do not pull on your neck.

demos.name: Curtsy Lunge
cues: Hold dumbbells and step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel, hips facing forward.
Drive back up through the front foot.

demos.name: Dead Bug
cues: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent over your hips, lower back pressed into the floor.
Lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return and alternate. The lower back never leaves the floor.

demos.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
cues: Lock your legs into the decline bench and set your shoulder blades.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control.
Press back up; have a spotter for the unrack and rerack.

demos.name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and the dumbbells over your lower chest.
Lower them to the sides of your lower chest with control.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

demos.name: Decline Push-Up
cues: Feet on a bench, hands on the floor, body straight.
Lower your chest to the floor keeping your hips in line.
Press back to the start. Emphasises the upper chest and shoulders.

demos.name: Diamond Push-Up
cues: Place your hands together under your chest so thumbs and index fingers form a diamond.
Lower your chest to your hands, elbows staying close to your sides.
Press back up fully.

demos.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Lie back with a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, palms forward.
Press both dumbbells up and slightly together over your chest.
Lower until your elbows are just below the bench, then press again.

demos.name: Dumbbell Curl
cues: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl both dumbbells to your shoulders, elbows pinned to your sides.
Lower slowly. Alternate arms if you prefer.

variants.name: EZ-Bar Curl
variants.note: An EZ bar in both hands.

demos.name: Dumbbell Fly
cues: Lie on a bench with dumbbells over your chest, palms facing, elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.

demos.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
cues: Upper back on a bench, one dumbbell resting across your hips.
Drive your hips up until they are level with your knees and shoulders.
Pause at the top, then lower until your hips nearly touch the floor.

demos.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise both arms out to the side until they are level with your shoulders.
Lower slowly. Lead with the elbows, not the hands.

variants.name: Band Lateral Raise
variants.note: A band under your feet instead of dumbbells.

demos.name: Dumbbell Pullover
cues: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
With a slight bend in the elbows, lower it behind your head until you feel a stretch under your arms.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats, keeping your ribs down.

demos.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Place one hand and knee on a bench, the other foot on the floor, back flat.
Row the dumbbell to your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower to a full stretch. Finish all reps before switching sides.

demos.name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
cues: Lie back with a dumbbell in each hand over your chest, palms facing.
Lower them beside your head by bending the elbows.
Extend back up, elbows pointing at the ceiling.

demos.name: Dumbbell Squat
cues: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down keeping your chest tall and the dumbbells close to your legs.
Stand back up without letting your knees cave inward.

demos.name: Cable Face Pull
cues: Set a rope at face height and grip it with palms facing in.
Pull toward your face, flaring your elbows and pulling the rope apart.
Finish with your hands beside your ears, then return slowly.

demos.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carry
cues: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand with a flat back.
Walk tall with your shoulders back and ribs down.
Walk for distance or time, then set the weights down with a flat back.

demos.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor with knees bent, dumbbells pressed up over your chest.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor, pause briefly.
Press back up. The floor limits range, making this shoulder-friendly.

demos.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
cues: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise them straight in front to shoulder height.
Lower under control without swinging.

demos.name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second, then lower slowly.

demos.name: Glute Kickback Machine
cues: Set the machine so the pad sits on the back of one foot or thigh.
Push one leg back and up by squeezing your glute, without arching your lower back.
Return slowly, finish the set, then switch to the other leg.

demos.name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands cupping the top end.
Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Sit down between your knees, elbows tracking inside them.
Pause at the bottom, then push the floor away to stand tall.

variants.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
variants.note: Hold the kettlebell by the horns.

demos.name: Good Morning
cues: Bar on your upper back, knees soft, feet hip-width.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Return by driving the hips forward. Start light; this loads the lower back.

demos.name: Hack Squat
cues: Set your shoulders under the pads with your feet mid-platform, shoulder-width apart.
Lower under control until your thighs are around parallel.
Drive up through the whole foot; do not let your heels lift.

demos.name: Hammer Curl
cues: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl up keeping the palms facing in the whole way.
Lower under control.

demos.name: Handstand Push-Up
cues: Kick up into a handstand against a wall, hands shoulder-width.
Lower until your head lightly touches the floor.
Press back to full lockout. Stack pads under your head to shorten the range.

demos.name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Raise your straight legs until they are at least parallel to the floor, curling your pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.

variants.name: Hanging Knee Raise
variants.note: Bend your knees as they come up: easier.

demos.name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
cues: Set both pulleys high and stand a step forward with a handle in each hand.
Sweep your hands down and together in front of your hips.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch. Emphasises the lower chest.

demos.name: Hip Abduction Machine
cues: Sit with the pads against the outside of your knees.
Push your knees apart as far as you can.
Return slowly to the start.

demos.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cues: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a padded bar across your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso and thighs are level.
Squeeze hard at the top with a neutral chin, then lower under control.

demos.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
cues: Set the bench to 30 degrees and lie back with your shoulder blades set.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, elbows tucked slightly.
Press straight up over the shoulders.

demos.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Set the bench to 30 degrees and start with dumbbells at your upper chest.
Press up and together, then lower under control to a full stretch.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned to the bench.

demos.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Sit back on a 45-degree bench with your arms hanging straight down.
Curl the dumbbells up without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower to a full stretch at the bottom.

demos.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
cues: Set the bench to 30 degrees and hold dumbbells over your upper chest.
Lower in a wide arc with a slight elbow bend.
Squeeze back to the top.

demos.name: Incline Push-Up
cues: Place your hands on a bench or wall, body straight.
Lower your chest to the surface, then press back up.
The lower the surface, the harder it gets.

demos.name: Inverted Row
cues: Set a barbell in a rack at about hip height and hang beneath it, body straight, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly. Lower the bar or raise your feet to progress.

demos.name: Jump Squat
cues: Squat to about parallel, then jump as high as you can.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink straight into the next rep.
Stop the set when your landings get loud or your knees start to cave.

demos.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
cues: Stand over the bell with feet hip-width and hinge down to grip the handle.
Flat back, chest up, then stand by pushing the floor away.
Lower it under control by pushing your hips back.

demos.name: Kettlebell Farmer's Carry
cues: Deadlift a kettlebell in each hand.
Walk tall, shoulders packed, without leaning.
Set them down under control.

demos.name: Kettlebell Press
cues: Clean the bell to the rack position at your shoulder, forearm vertical.
Press it straight overhead, rotating the palm to face forward at the top.
Lower back to the rack. Complete the reps, then switch sides.

demos.name: Kettlebell Row
cues: Hinge with a flat back, one hand braced on your thigh or a bench.
Row the bell to your hip, elbow close to your body.
Lower to a full stretch. Switch sides after all reps.

demos.name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Start with the bell a step in front of you, hinge and hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to float the bell to chest height; your arms only guide it.
Let it fall, hinge again as it passes your thighs, and repeat. Never squat the swing.

demos.name: Landmine Press
cues: Anchor one end of a barbell in a corner or landmine and hold the other end at your shoulder.
Press up and forward along the arc of the bar until your arm is straight.
Lower under control, then switch arms. The angle makes this shoulder-friendly.

demos.name: Landmine Row
cues: Straddle a bar anchored in a landmine and hold it near the loaded end.
Hinge forward with a flat back and pull the bar to your chest.
Lower it under control.

demos.name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Sit with your thighs under the pad and grip the bar just wider than shoulders.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, leaning back only slightly.
Return slowly until your arms are straight and your lats stretch.

demos.name: Lateral Lunge
cues: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and step wide to one side.
Sit back into that hip, keeping the other leg straight and both feet flat.
Push back to standing and repeat on the other side.

demos.name: Leg Extension
cues: Sit with the pad on your shins and your knees in line with the machine pivot.
Extend your legs until straight, pausing at the top.
Lower slowly. Use a smaller range if your knees complain.

demos.name: Leg Press
cues: Sit with your back and hips flat against the pad, feet hip-width on the platform.
Release the safeties and lower the platform until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up without locking the knees out hard, and keep your lower back on the pad.

demos.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
cues: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform.
Keep your knees almost straight and push the platform away with your toes.
Lower slowly into a deep stretch.

demos.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
cues: Set both pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand.
Sweep your hands up and together to eye level.
Lower slowly. Emphasises the upper chest.

demos.name: Lying Leg Curl
cues: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly without lifting your hips.

demos.name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips.
Keep your legs straight and raise them until they point up.
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch off the floor.

demos.name: Machine Chest Press
cues: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

demos.name: Machine Crunch
cues: Sit with the pads against your chest or hold the handles.
Crunch forward, rounding your upper back.
Return slowly to the start.

demos.name: Machine Lateral Raise
cues: Sit with the pads against the outside of your upper arms.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

demos.name: Machine Preacher Curl
cues: Set the seat so your armpits rest on top of the pad.
Curl the handles up to full contraction.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

demos.name: Machine Row
cues: Set the chest pad so the handles are level with your lower chest.
Pull the handles back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return until your arms are straight and your lats are stretched.

demos.name: Machine Shoulder Press
cues: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Press overhead until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly back to the start.

demos.name: Machine Triceps Extension
cues: Set the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Extend the handles until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the start.

demos.name: Mountain Climber
cues: Start in a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.

demos.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
cues: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something solid or held by a partner.
Lower your body forward as slowly as possible, hips straight.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up to help the return.

demos.name: Kettlebell Overhead Carry
cues: Press a kettlebell overhead and lock the arm out, biceps by your ear.
Walk with ribs down and the bell steady overhead.
Switch sides after the distance.

demos.name: Barbell Overhead Press
cues: Hold the bar at your collarbones, grip just outside shoulder-width, elbows slightly in front.
Brace your glutes and trunk, then press the bar straight up, moving your head back out of the way.
Finish with the bar over the middle of your foot and your head through. Lower to the start.

demos.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands cupping the top end.
Lower it behind your head by bending only the elbows.
Press back to straight arms; keep your elbows pointing forward.

demos.name: Cable Pallof Press
cues: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height, holding the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press your hands straight out in front and resist the pull to rotate.
Return to your chest. Switch sides after all reps.

demos.name: Pec Deck
cues: Sit with your back flat and your forearms or hands on the pads.
Bring the pads together in front of your chest.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.

demos.name: Pendlay Row
cues: Set up with your torso parallel to the floor and the bar on the ground.
Pull explosively to your lower chest, then return the bar fully to the floor.
Every rep starts dead from the floor.

demos.name: Pike Push-Up
cues: From a push-up position, walk your feet in so your hips are high and your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up. Raise your feet on a bench to progress.

demos.name: Pistol Squat
cues: Stand on one leg with the other leg held straight out in front.
Squat all the way down on the standing leg, arms forward for balance.
Stand up without touching the free foot down. Hold a support to regress.

demos.name: Plank
cues: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your hips neither sag nor pike.
Hold for time; stop when your form breaks.

demos.name: Pull-Up
cues: Hang from the bar with palms facing away, hands just wider than shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar, driving your elbows down and back.
Lower until your arms are fully straight. Add weight or reps to progress.

variants.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
variants.note: A band under your knees takes some of your weight.

demos.name: Push Press
cues: Hold the bar at your collarbones as for an overhead press.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, then drive up explosively and press the bar overhead.
Lock out overhead, then lower to the shoulders and reset.

demos.name: Push-Up
cues: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up without letting your hips sag or pike. Elevate your hands to make it easier.

demos.name: Rack Pull
cues: Set the bar on pins or blocks just below your knees.
Grip it, brace, and keep your back flat.
Stand tall by driving your hips forward, then lower the bar back to the pins.

demos.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging below your chest.
Raise both arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower under control.

demos.name: Reverse Crunch
cues: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips.
Curl your pelvis up, lifting your hips off the floor.
Lower slowly without arching your back.

demos.name: Reverse Curl
cues: Hold a bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Curl it up keeping your wrists straight and elbows by your sides.
Lower slowly. Use less weight than a normal curl.

demos.name: Reverse Lunge
cues: Hold dumbbells at your sides and step one foot back.
Lower until the back knee is just off the floor, keeping the front knee over the foot.
Push through the front foot to return. Easier on the knees than a forward lunge.

demos.name: Reverse Pec Deck
cues: Sit facing the pad with the handles in front of you.
Pull your arms out and back, squeezing your rear shoulders.
Return slowly.

demos.name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Start standing with the bar at your hips, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs, keeping your back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch (usually just below the knee), then drive your hips forward to stand.

demos.name: Russian Twist
cues: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your shoulders to one side, then to the other, under control.
Keep your feet down to make it easier, or lift them to make it harder.

demos.name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit tall with feet braced and a slight bend in the knees.
Pull the handle to your stomach, driving your elbows back and chest up.
Let your arms straighten fully without rounding your back.

demos.name: Seated Calf Raise
cues: Sit with the pad on your thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform.
Raise your heels as high as possible.
Lower slowly into a stretch.

demos.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Sit upright with a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms forward.
Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower until the dumbbells are level with your ears, then repeat.

demos.name: Seated Leg Curl
cues: Sit with the pad above your heels and the thigh pad locked down.
Curl your heels under the seat as far as possible.
Return slowly to straight legs.

demos.name: Side Plank
cues: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and feet stacked.
Lift your hips so your body is a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides.

demos.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
cues: Stand on one foot on a step, holding a support for balance.
Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower below the step.
Finish all reps before switching legs.

demos.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg held up.
Drive the planted heel down to lift your hips, keeping them level.
Lower slowly and complete all reps before switching legs.

demos.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hold a dumbbell in the hand opposite your standing leg.
Hinge forward, letting the free leg travel back, until your torso is near parallel.
Return to standing by driving the standing hip forward. Keep your hips square.

demos.name: Sissy Squat
cues: Stand holding a support, rise onto the balls of your feet.
Lean back and bend your knees, keeping your hips straight, until your knees are near the floor.
Pull yourself back up with your quads.

demos.name: Barbell Skull Crusher
cues: Lie on a bench holding the bar over your chest, hands shoulder-width.
Bend only your elbows to lower the bar to just above your forehead.
Extend back to the start without moving your upper arms.

demos.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
cues: Position the bench so the bar lowers to your lower chest.
Unhook and lower the bar under control to your chest.
Press up and re-hook at the end.

demos.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
cues: Set a block under the bar and stand on it with the balls of your feet, bar on your upper back.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower into a full stretch under control.

demos.name: Smith Machine Incline Press
cues: Set a bench at 30 to 45 degrees under the bar so it lines up with your upper chest.
Unhook the bar and lower it to your upper chest with elbows slightly tucked.
Press up until your arms are straight, then re-hook the bar.

demos.name: Smith Machine Lunge
cues: Stand in a split stance under the bar, front foot well ahead.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, front knee over your foot.
Drive up through your front foot; finish the set on one leg, then switch legs.

demos.name: Smith Machine Squat
cues: Set the bar on your upper back and place your feet slightly ahead of the bar.
Unhook, then squat down keeping your torso upright against the fixed bar path.
Press up and re-hook at the end of the set.

demos.name: Split Squat
cues: Take a long stride stance and stay there for the set.
Lower straight down until the rear knee is just off the floor.
Push up through the front foot. Finish all reps, then switch legs. Hold a wall for balance if needed.

demos.name: Standing Calf Raise
cues: Stand with the balls of your feet on the platform and shoulders under the pads.
Rise as high as possible onto your toes.
Lower until your heels drop below the platform for a full stretch.

variants.name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
variants.note: Dumbbells at your sides instead of the machine.

demos.name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Stand with a dumbbell at each shoulder and your trunk braced.
Press overhead without leaning back; ribs down.
Lower under control to shoulder height.

demos.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
cues: Hold dumbbells and place one whole foot on a knee-high box.
Drive through that foot to stand on the box without pushing off the floor.
Step down under control. Finish the reps on one side before switching.

demos.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
cues: Stand with the bar at your hips and knees nearly straight.
Hinge down with a flat back as far as your hamstrings allow.
Return by driving the hips forward. Range of motion is set by flexibility, not the floor.

demos.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
cues: Stand facing a high pulley with a straight bar, arms nearly straight.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs, keeping your arms straight.
Return slowly until your arms are overhead.

demos.name: Suitcase Carry
cues: Hold one heavy dumbbell at your side.
Walk tall without leaning toward or away from the weight.
Switch hands and repeat the same distance.

demos.name: Sumo Deadlift
cues: Take a wide stance with toes out and grip the bar inside your legs.
Push your knees out, chest up, and drive the floor apart as you stand.
Lock out by squeezing your glutes; keep the bar close on the way down.

demos.name: Sumo Squat
cues: Stand wide with toes turned out, holding one dumbbell hanging between your legs.
Squat straight down, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Drive up and squeeze your glutes; keep the dumbbell close to your body.

demos.name: T-Bar Row
cues: Straddle a landmine bar with a V-handle under it, hinge to about 45 degrees.
Row the handle to your chest with a flat back.
Lower under control without letting your hips rise.

demos.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cues: Stand inside the trap bar with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handles, chest up and back flat.
Stand up by pushing the floor away, then lower the bar the same way.

demos.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
cues: Hinge forward with your upper arm parallel to the floor and elbow bent.
Extend your arm straight back, squeezing the triceps.
Return without dropping the elbow. Complete the reps, then switch arms.

demos.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
cues: Grip a straight bar on a high pulley, elbows pinned to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Return until your forearms pass parallel; keep your elbows still.

variants.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
variants.note: A rope: spread its ends at the bottom.

demos.name: Upright Row
cues: Hold a bar in front of your thighs with hands a little wider than shoulder-width.
Pull it up along your body, leading with the elbows, to about chest height.
Lower slowly. Stop lower if your shoulders pinch.

demos.name: Walking Lunge
cues: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step forward into a lunge.
Lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor, front shin vertical.
Push through the front foot and step straight into the next lunge with the other leg, alternating as you walk.
